description: Newlines inside a directive in a quoted template are ignored
notes: The spec says newlines are ignored inside parentheses, brackets, braces and function call arguments, but doesn't say so for template directives, and it describes a quoted template as a single-line expression. hashicorp/hcl ignores newlines inside directives: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(false) before reading the directive.
